_comment: Working generation parameters for temple-stories. These are the values that have actually produced accepted output. Every one of them is here because getting it wrong cost something.

callConvention._comment: The MCP bridge rejects top-level arguments. EVERYTHING goes inside `params`, including the model id and the prompt. Arrays passed as a bare top-level argument are stringified and rejected; nested inside `params` they work.
callConvention.mediaUpload: media_upload{filename:<abs path>} -> curl PUT to upload_url -> media_confirm{type,media_id}. Raw HTTPS URLs are not accepted as references; upload and use the media_id.
callConvention.pollResults: show_generations (no arguments). jobs_wait and show_generation_by_ids both require an array argument the bridge cannot pass.

image._resolutionNote: CRITICAL. The parameter is `resolution`, NOT `quality`. Options are 1k | 2k | 4k, default 1k. Passing `quality` is silently ignored and you get 1k (768x1376), which is below the 1080x1920 frame. `2k` returns 1536x2752. This error cost 1.5 credits on 2026-11-23.
image.referenceStrategy: Pass the authority for the thing being corrected FIRST, the style/character carrier second, and say in the prompt which reference governs what. To avoid a rejected element bleeding back in, crop it out of the reference before uploading.
image.moderation: Uploads are moderation-screened. design/directions/B-folk-narrative.png is rejected as 'nsfw' (bare-chested devotees) and cannot be used as a reference. Use the accepted B-derived assets instead: assets/pilot/shot3-patnam-v3-final.png and assets/pilot/shot2-deity-close.png. Dress every figure in prompts; 'fully clothed' avoids rejections.
image.silentFailures: A generation can be charged and never appear in show_generations. Re-running that one job is completing a failed job, not retrying a rejected one — record it as such.

video._durationNote: Kling accepts 3-15 s. Match the clip length to the shot so the cut does not need a frozen tail.
video._soundNote: Always 'off'. The bed is synthesised in FFmpeg at no cost and stays under our control.
video.outputFormat: 1076x1928 @ 24 fps — always resample to 1080x1920 @ 30 on extraction

retrieval.command:
sh scripts/fetch-narration.sh              # list recent items
           sh scripts/fetch-narration.sh <history_item_id> <out.mp3>   # download + verify
retrieval.cli: elevenlabs history list --page-size N --format json ; elevenlabs history get_audio --history-item-id <id> --format raw > out.mp3

flowsEndpointBlocked.result: HTTP 402 payment_required / paid_plan_required — 'This endpoint requires a Pro plan or above.'
flowsEndpointBlocked.note: NOT an auth or scope failure. The OAuth key carries the `flows` scope and authenticates fine; the account is on the Starter tier and every Flows endpoint (get and list alike) is gated above it. Speech History returns the same audio and is available on Starter.

retrieval.idMapping: Flow generation_ids (e.g. PIGwTBig8ZhaioOMb1ra) are NOT history_item_ids. Match the history item by date_unix against the flow's created_at, and confirm by duration.
retrieval.verified: 2026-11-23 — two existing takes of the corrected line retrieved: 11.96 s and 11.81 s, mp3 44.1 kHz mono, full decode clean. Saved as audio/01-line-corrected-take1.mp3 / take2.mp3. No new paid generation was made.

auth.method: ElevenLabs CLI onboarding (OAuth PKCE) — `npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard connect --wait --env-path .env.local`
auth.storage: .env.local (gitignored; the CLI confirms gitignored:true). Never open, print or cat it. `onboard check` verifies it.

extraction._comment: Remotion cannot decode video on this machine (macOS 12 vs the compositor's macOS 15 requirement). Clips are pre-extracted to JPEG sequences by the project's own FFmpeg.

render._note: `npx remotion render` does not work here. See docs/SETUP_NOTES.md.

frozen._comment: Settled decisions. Do not spend credits revisiting these.

shot-patnam.note: Geometry matched to design/references/patnam-pedda-patam-photo.jpg. The absence of red accents is accepted. No further generations for its colour details. FROZEN by Karunakar 2026-11-23: no further generations for its colour details.

rules: No AI-generated Telugu or Devanagari text inside images, ever. Captions are typeset in Remotion.
No automatic paid retries. If a generation misses, report it and stop.
Karunakar uploads. Nothing publishes without his full watch-through.

assembly._comment: Forced by disk, now the standard pipeline. This machine ran to 836 MB free during episode 1.
assembly.pictureTrack: Assemble all clips in ONE ffmpeg filter_complex pass (trim/setpts/fps/scale/crop/concat). Never extract a full episode to a frame sequence — 2030 frames of JPEG needs well over a gigabyte.
assembly.captions: Remotion renders ONLY a transparent caption layer: npx remotion render <Comp> <dir> --sequence --image-format=png --image-sequence-pattern=cap-[frame].png --license-key=free-license
assembly.compositing: Overlay the caption PNGs onto the picture track in chunks of ~400 frames, deleting each chunk's PNGs immediately, then concat the segments. Rendering all caption frames at once hit ENOSPC at frame 1896 of 2030.
assembly.soundBed: Synthesised in Python to a WAV (air/noise + low drone + decaying bell partials), mixed under the narration at 0.34 through alimiter. Zero credits. ffmpeg-static here has NO drawtext filter.

episodeEconomics.note: The earlier '~20 credits per episode' figure came from a 16 s pilot and does not hold for a full episode.
